default.notes: Entry is controlled by Israel — this nationality needs an Israeli visa, obtained from an Israeli embassy, to reach the West Bank via Ben Gurion Airport or the Allenby Bridge; the Palestinian Authority issues no visas of its own.

groups.notes: Entry runs through Israeli border control: this nationality is visa-exempt for Israel but must obtain the ETA-IL electronic travel authorisation online before travel — admission (up to 90 days) is at Israel's discretion and covers onward travel to most of the West Bank.

IL.notes: Israeli law bars Israeli citizens from entering Area A, the parts of the West Bank under full Palestinian Authority control (including central Ramallah, Nablus and Bethlehem); Gaza is closed to entry.

PS.notes: Home territory — but movement for Palestinian passport and ID holders is controlled by Israeli permits at all crossings and checkpoints.
